jobs.title: Software Engineer, New Grad
jobs.description:
Who we are
  
  
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.
  
  
Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.
  
  
Your role
  
  
Stripe is large enough that individual products and projects can be rapidly deployed to a meaningful fraction of the world’s businesses, but small enough that individual agency still has outsized impact. Small teams can impact how millions of businesses grow. Right now the global economy is replatforming around AI, creating new opportunities for growth. We’re at the center of this, and we think the best work is still in front of us.
  
  
To meet this moment, we’re looking for people who move with urgency, like hard problems, and want their work to matter at a time of great change. If that’s you, there’s no better place to build your career.
  
  
Who you are
  
  

* Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.
* Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before.
* Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

**Minimum Requirements**

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science or a directly related field, obtained by summer 2027, or equivalent work experience; New grad candidates should have no more than 18 months of professional experience (excluding internship experience).
* Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Java, Ruby, JavaScript, Scala, and Go. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present.
* Experience from either previous internships or working collaboratively on multi-person coding projects (in a university or professional setting).
* Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts.
* Clear written communication skills, with the ability to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes.
* Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge.
* Experience in code review practices, and an understanding of how to safely update production systems.
* Familiarity with navigating and managing work in large code bases.
* Experience leading small projects independently, and contributing to larger projects alongside peers.
* Ability to operate with high agency in navigating complex technical obstacles independently, knowing precisely when to unblock oneself and when to ask for help.

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Stripes on the Works in Progress team based in the London, UK office also work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career.
  
  

* Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience
* Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence
* Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment

**What You’ll Be Part Of**
The Android Bluetooth Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, integrating, and optimizing Bluetooth connectivity solutions for Android-based platforms. The role requires strong expertise in Android application and framework development, Bluetooth Classic and BLE protocols, and hands-on experience with Bluetooth profile implementation and debugging. The engineer will work closely with platform, middleware, and application teams to ensure seamless communication between Android devices and external peripherals while delivering high-performance and reliable wireless connectivity solutions.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Design, develop, and maintain Bluetooth communication features and frameworks for Android applications using Java and Kotlin.
* Develop, integrate, and optimize Bluetooth Classic and BLE profiles, including proprietary and standard implementations.
* Work with Android Bluetooth stack components (Fluoride/Gabeldorsche) and Android Framework layers (android, Bluetooth).
* Debug and resolve complex Bluetooth connectivity issues such as pairing failures, reconnection issues, throughput bottlenecks, latency concerns, and power consumption challenges.
* Analyze protocol-level communication using Bluetooth packet analysers and logs.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including platform, middleware and hardware teams to deliver robust connectivity solutions.
* Support system integration, feature validation, and performance optimization activities.
* Review software designs, participate in code reviews, and ensure adherence to development best practices.

**What Makes You A Strong Fit**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in Android application or Android framework development.
* Strong programming skills in Java and Kotlin.
* Good understanding of Android architecture components, services, IPC mechanisms, and background processing.
* Experience with Android Bluetooth SDK and Bluetooth framework development.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

**Bonus Points if You Have**

* Strong knowledge of Bluetooth Core Specifications, including Bluetooth Classic and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE).
* Experience working with Android Bluetooth Stack (Fluoride/Gabeldorsche).
* Familiarity with Bluetooth HCI logs, ADB, and protocol analysis tools.
* Exposure to embedded systems, wireless communication protocols, and connectivity solutions.

**Things To Know**

* This role is based at HARMAN International (India) Private Limited, Salarpuria Sattva Knowledge Court (SSKC), Bangalore.

**What You Can Expect**

* A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite three days a week.
* Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)
* Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs
* Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being
* Tuition reimbursement support
* Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development

No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.

Job Title: Software Engineer – Integrations & Client Engineering

Company: Vasool (Vasool.ai)

Department: Engineering / Solutions Architecture

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: Bangalore

About Vasool:

Vasool is an AI-native B2B accounts receivable and debt resolution platform. We empower CFOs, enterprise credit teams, and SME business owners to automate dispute resolution, streamline payment collections, and safeguard statutory compliance (MSMED Act, IBC, Section 138) through intelligent omnichannel negotiation.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a proactive Software Engineer to bridge the gap between our core platform and our clients’ accounting ecosystems. In this role, you will be the owner of client integrations—designing data sync connectors, onboarding client ledgers, and ensuring zero-latency data pipelines between client ERPs (Tally, Zoho, SAP) and Vasool’s cloud infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities:

• Build & Maintain ERP Connectors: Design and deploy real-time and scheduled synchronization bridges for Tally Prime (XML/TDL/ODBC), Zoho Books, Busy, and enterprise accounting software.

• Client Technical Facilitation: Collaborate directly with prospective and onboarded clients’ finance and IT teams to map charts of accounts, configure webhooks, validate ledger balances, and resolve data discrepancies.

• API & Omnichannel Integrations: Maintain and optimize integrations across communication channels (Meta WhatsApp Cloud API, Gupshup, Exotel voice telephony) and Indian payment rails (UPI Intent, Razorpay, Cashfree).

• Full-Stack Feature Delivery: Develop performant backend services in Python (FastAPI, Pydantic) and intuitive UI configuration tools in React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

• Reliability & Monitoring: Implement logging, automated sync failure alerting, and error-recovery routines across distributed client sync agents.

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

• 1 to 4 years of professional experience building backend systems in Python (FastAPI preferred, Django/Flask acceptable) and frontend features in React / TypeScript.

• Proven track record working with third-party APIs, webhooks, XML/JSON parsing, and database transactions.

• Experience or strong familiarity with accounting/ERP data structures (Invoices, Credit Notes, Ledgers, Aging, TDS/GST). Prior experience with Tally integration is a major plus.

• Strong debugging skills and high comfort interacting with enterprise clients to solve technical roadblocks.

Bonus Points If You Have:

• Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP Cloud Run, Secret Manager) and Firebase (Firestore, Auth).

• Familiarity with LLM APIs (Google Gemini, OpenAI) and telephony providers (Exotel, Twilio).

• Prior experience at a B2B Fintech or SaaS startup.

What We Offer:

• Fast-paced startup environment with high autonomy and direct impact on working capital for hundreds of companies.

• Competitive compensation and equity options.

• Mentorship and opportunities to architect enterprise-grade financial infrastructure.

How to Apply:

Apply directly via LinkedIn or email your resume and portfolio/GitHub link to [careers@vasoolai.com] with the subject line "Software Engineer (Integrations) - [Your Name]" or directly apply in the link “https://vasoolai.com/careers”.

**About EDS**
-------------

EDS is the unified digital platform that powers GE HealthCare’s global software portfolio. It brings together reusable UI components, design patterns and accessibility standards to connect user experience and engineering.

By encouraging teams to reduce, reuse and recycle, EDS helps product teams eliminate redundant work and build consistent, accessible applications. These foundational components support clinical and operational applications and allow teams to focus on patient safety.

**The opportunity**
-------------------

We are looking for a Software Engineer to build and maintain reusable components for the Ethos Design System. As EDS grows across GE HealthCare’s product portfolio, you will help make its components easy for teams to discover, integrate and use.

You will work with senior engineers, architects, UX designers, product owners, Lead System Designers, DevOps and quality engineers. You will own assigned components and features from implementation through testing, documentation and maintenance, with support and guidance from senior team members.

**Key responsibilities**

### **Component engineering and API design**

* Develop and maintain reusable, encapsulated UI components using Lit and Web Components.
* Write clean JavaScript and TypeScript, semantic HTML, and scoped CSS using SASS.
* Implement component APIs, including properties, events and slots, following established design system patterns.
* Investigate defects and contribute to component performance, reliability and maintainability.

### **Cross-framework integration**

Job Description: AI/ML Engineer (AWS)

About the role

We’re looking for an AI/ML engineer to design, build and run AI-powered applications on AWS. This includes large language model (LLM) applications, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and classic machine learning. You’ll take ideas from prototype to production, with a focus on reliability, security, cost and measurable quality. The role is hired at two levels.

Responsibilities

* Design and build LLM applications: prompt design, RAG pipelines, tool or function calling, and multi-step agents.
* Build and deploy models and AI services on AWS: Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, Step Functions, DynamoDB, S3 and OpenSearch.
* Set up evaluation: offline test sets, LLM-as-judge, regression checks, and tracking of quality, latency and cost.
* Add observability and tracing for AI workloads, for example OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, LangFuse or similar.
* Build in safety from the start: guardrails, prompt-injection defences, access control, human approval for risky actions, and handling of personal data.
* Write production-quality, tested code and maintain CI/CD and infrastructure as code (Terraform or CDK).
* Work with product, platform and security teams; write clear design documents and runbooks.
* Keep up with the field and assess new models, frameworks and AWS services.

Requirements

AI/ML Engineer (about 3–6 years)

* Strong Python; solid software engineering (testing, code review, APIs, Git).
* Hands-on experience shipping at least one LLM or ML system to production.
* Practical AWS experience: Bedrock and/or SageMaker, Lambda, IAM, VPC basics, and serverless or container deployment.
* Experience with RAG and vector search (OpenSearch, pgvector or similar) and embeddings.
* Experience with agent or orchestration frameworks (for example LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Strands, Bedrock Agents) and protocols such as MCP.
* Understanding of evaluation methods, model limits, hallucination, and cost and latency trade-offs.
* Infrastructure as code (Terraform or CDK) and CI/CD.
* Security awareness: OAuth/OIDC, least-privilege IAM, secrets management.

* Good Python and ML fundamentals (supervised learning, model evaluation, basic statistics).
* A degree in CS, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands-on project work with LLM APIs, RAG or ML models (internships, open source or personal projects count).
* Familiarity with core AWS services; an AWS certification is a plus.
* Eagerness to learn production engineering practices: testing, monitoring and security.

Nice to have

* AWS certifications: Machine Learning Engineer – Associate, AI Practitioner, Solutions Architect. Fine-tuning or adapting models (LoRA, distillation) and MLOps tools (MLflow, SageMaker Pipelines).
* Experience with multi-agent systems, agent-to-agent (A2A) communication, or policy engines.
* Docker, Kubernetes (EKS) and Linux.
* Experience with responsible-AI practices and governance.

What we look for

* Clear thinking and plain communication with technical and non-technical colleagues.
* Ownership: builds, measures and improves things end to end.
* Judgement about when AI is, and isn’t, the right tool.

Omnidian, Inc. is a fast-growing Series C tech-enabled service company revolutionizing performance assurance for the distributed solar and energy storage industries. Omnidian is building a more sustainable future for the planet through our passionate teams, our innovative technology, and by creating an amazing customer experience.

We are a certified B Corp that formed in the US in 2016 and have been growing globally since then. We expanded to Australia in 2022, acquired Solar Service Guys in Australia in 2025, and have opened up a new talent hub in India in 2026. Be part of the "First Wave" experience! **The Job**
-----------

The Analytics Engineer will build and maintain the data pipelines behind Omnidian's performance and financial reporting. Our platform is moving away from API-driven workflows toward set-based, SQL-first pipelines, and this role sits at the center of that shift.

This role is roughly 80% data and 20% backend engineering. Most of your time goes to SQL transformations and data modeling, done with software engineering habits: testing, versioning, code review, and clean deployments. The team is upstream of most of the company's data, so your work reaches Finance, Operations, Product, and leadership reporting.

At Omnidian we believe in trust and autonomy. How you create an impact is ultimately up to you. Here is an outline of some of the things you’ll be doing:

**Pipeline Development & Migration (50%)**
